content: Two patterns for AWS Secrets Manager + ECS/NestJS: (1) ECS task definition 'secrets' field with valueFrom pointing at the Secrets Manager ARN - ECS agent injects as env vars before container starts, app just reads via @nestjs/config, no SDK/IAM runtime calls needed (recommended default, simplest). (2) Runtime fetch via @aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager SDK call at bootstrap before creating the DB pool - needed only for secret rotation without restart. Task execution role needs secretsmanager:GetSecretValue (+kms:Decrypt if custom KMS key).
